scripts.compile: npm run server && npm run compile:client
scripts.compile:tests: dotnet build ../../experiments/Ranvier.View.Arms.FablePlugin/Ranvier.View.Arms.FablePlugin.fsproj -c Release -v q && node tests/arms-fresh.mjs generated-tests Release
scripts.test:dom: npm run compile:tests -- --define RANVIER_VIEW_COUNTERS && node --test tests/dom.test.mjs tests/scheduled.test.mjs tests/lifetime.test.mjs tests/representation.test.mjs tests/component.test.mjs tests/binding.test.mjs tests/mounting-investigation.test.mjs tests/integration.test.mjs tests/server.test.mjs tests/sugar-server.test.mjs tests/sugar-emit.test.mjs tests/sugar-release.test.mjs tests/elmish-nested.test.mjs tests/sugar-rows.test.mjs benchmarks/frameworks/gates.test.mjs tests/conformance.test.mjs tests/conformance-diff.test.mjs tests/conformance-host.test.mjs tests/restructured.test.mjs
scripts.test:arms: npm run compile:tests -- --define RANVIER_VIEW_COUNTERS && node --test tests/arms-server.test.mjs tests/arms.test.mjs tests/arms-hydration.test.mjs benchmarks/frameworks/run-sources.test.mjs && node tests/sugar-counters-build.mjs && node --test tests/arms-counters.test.mjs
scripts.test:sugar-debug: npm run compile:tests && node tests/arms-fresh.mjs generated-tests-debug Debug && node --test tests/sugar-debug.test.mjs tests/arms-debug.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run compile:tests && npm run compile && playwright test
scripts.test:conformance-inspect: npm run compile:tests -- --define RANVIER_VIEW_COUNTERS --define RANVIER_VIEW_INSPECT && node --test tests/conformance.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:build && npm run test:dom && npm run test:sugar-debug && npm run test:sugar-counters && npm run test:conformance-inspect && npm run test:browser
scripts.server: dotnet build Server/Server.fsproj -c Release -m:1 -p:BuildInParallel=false && dotnet run --project Server/Server.fsproj -c Release --no-build -- --write-pages
